undistort_image: undistort a raw Aria camera frame using fisheye624 calibration to linear or spherical output
process_frame: process an Aria frame by undistorting the image and saving it to an output folder with metadata
interpolate_aria_pose: interpolate a closed-loop trajectory pose at a given capture timestamp using bisection search
read_frames_from_metadata: read and parse frame metadata from a transforms JSON file into a list of AriaFrame objects
storePly: store 3D point cloud data with xyz coordinates, normals, and rgb colors to a PLY file
